description:
As a Realtor, we wear a lot of hats… but my favorite one? 👒 𝗡𝗮𝗻𝗻𝘆 😂💕

Shaqualle & Ashley were first sent to me by my Ghanian brother Anakwa 🤎 and helping them buy their 𝗳𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗲 was such a special moment. Back then, they had one little one.

Now? 𝗔 𝗙𝗔𝗠𝗜𝗟𝗬 𝗢𝗙 𝗙𝗢𝗨𝗥. 🥹👶🏽👶🏽

Watching them grow, level up, and step into their 𝘀𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗱 𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗲 in Texas just melts my heart.

They are 𝘀𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘁. 𝗗𝗿𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗻. 𝗕𝗲𝗮𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗳𝘂𝗹 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗼𝘂𝘁. The kind of couple that makes you think, “Wow… if only I had it this together at their age.” 😅👏🏽

Seeing their babies run around while we close on 𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗲 #2 hits different. This is why I love what I do. It’s not just contracts and keys. It’s chapters. It’s legacy. It’s 𝗯𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗲𝗮𝗹𝘁𝗵 for your family. 🇺🇸🏡

Military families — this is what 𝗣𝗖𝗦 𝗱𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗿𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 can look like. One move at a time. One smart decision at a time. 💪🏽

Shaqualle & Ashley, thank you for trusting me 𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗶𝗻. Your loyalty means more than you know.

At this point… we’re not just client and Realtor. 𝗪𝗲’𝗿𝗲 𝗳𝗮𝗺𝗶𝗹𝘆. 🤍

𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝘂𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 on your 𝗦𝗘𝗖𝗢𝗡𝗗 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝘆 in the great state of Texas!!! 🌟🏡

Let’s keep building. 🔑✨
